data.title: Chelsea Residences
data.about:
The last phase of Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is launching soon, and EOIs are now being collected for priority access. Located in Maritime City, Dubai’s first football-themed waterfront development brings the spirit of Chelsea FC to branded luxury living, making it a standout option for buyers interested in off-plan purchases in Dubai.

The sea-view apartments feature premium 1, 2, and 3-bedrooms with panoramic sea views, modern interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtfully planned layouts. Residents can enjoy club-inspired amenities, including the world’s first blue sand beach, rooftop football pitch, football simulation room, athlete performance training center, wellness spaces, family areas, and resort-style leisure experiences.

DAMAC Dubai is one of the pioneers of branded residences in Dubai, partnering with globally recognised brands such as Versace, de GRISOGONO, Cavalli, Paramount Hotels & Resorts, and Chelsea F.C.

characteristics_module.title: Live the Legacy! Powered by Chelsea, Built by DAMAC.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Final-Release Opportunity: Limited last-phase availability gives early registrants a chance to secure units before wider market demand increases.
  • 1% Monthly Payment Plan: A flexible payment structure makes ownership more accessible for buyers exploring off-plan investment in Dubai.
  • High-Growth Waterfront District: Maritime City continues to attract attention as a centrally connected coastal destination with strong future potential.
  • Lifestyle-Led Investment Appeal: The project blends branded positioning, waterfront value, and leisure-focused living for both investors and end users.
  • Strong Rental Potential: Its branded concept, sea-view setting, and central location can support long-term rental demand from lifestyle-driven tenants.
  • Easy City Connectivity: Residents benefit from smooth access to key destinations, business hubs, leisure districts, and Dubai’s main road networks.

location_tile.title: Dubai Maritime City’s Newest Branded Project
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located within Dubai Maritime City, Chelsea Residences enjoys a prime position in one of the best areas in Dubai to buy property. Dubai Maritime City combines waterfront living with excellent connectivity, placing residents just minutes from Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Port Rashid, and Dubai International Airport. 

As infrastructure and premium residential developments continue to transform the district, it is increasingly recognised as one of the best places to buy property in Dubai for both end users and investors. With flat prices in Dubai continuing to rise across established waterfront locations, Dubai Maritime City presents strong potential for long-term capital appreciation and attractive investment returns.

  • 14 Minutes to J1 Beach
  • 18 Minutes to Metro
  • 20 Minutes to DXB Airport
  • 15 minutes to City Walk
